summary: A tally-stick carver's bench that is unmistakable from one crop and has real depth under it — a ladder keyed on days kept that flattens at 217, a reading chosen by a rota that reads its own strengths, a wax that costs only the sitting, and three doors opened by counting — held back by a win that lands under the tab bar, a chisel drawn from rounded rectangles, and three earned rungs the carver promises and the app never delivers.
fixes: Lift the praise line out of the wax stick's HStack onto its own row under the stave, and pad the face's bottom so the rack the scored stave flies into is not cut in half by the tab bar.
Draw design/art/chisel.svg as mock 1 draws it — tapered ash handle, brass ferrule, bevelled lit blade — and use Image("Chisel") instead of the three stacked rounded rectangles in ChiselGlyph.
Gate the .best tier on run.isClean so "NOT ONE WAX, AND YOUR BEST" can never print over a waxed stave, and key bestCleanRun per counter rather than one shared AppStorage key.

Build the chalk at three staves — a stave in the rack can be tapped and named on its end-grain — and either build mark and wall or drop them from Bench.earned, so the sitting card never promises a thing that does not exist.

Move the rack into the bench's scroll so there is no dead 40% between the staves and the rail, and replace the NavigationLink inside the List with a path Button so the three system disclosure chevrons go.
Redraw the strip's days with NotchShape's two facets on the brass rule, as mock 1 has them, instead of plain rectangles.
At accessibility text sizes put the end-grain date stamp under the stave rather than over its end, and label the ledger header's week and month figures in the stencil caps.
